producer_judgment.rationale: Both are Class-5 Content SFIs (rank 4) under Curricular Goal CG-4 on measurement, but they sit under different competencies and express substantively different skills. Same-rank direction is justified by this concrete-measurement-to-conversion/application shift rather than by shared ancestry, page proximity, or the 'milligram/weight/measurement' token overlap alone.
